# Stoneskin (`spells:stoneskin`)
**Level 4 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes) | **Duration:** up to 1 hour | **Classes:** [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
